        {
            float loKey = _keys[lo];
            float hiKey = _keys[hi];

            if (loKey == hiKey)

                    return true;

                break;
            }

            ulong range = unchecked(Coordinate(hiKey) - Coordinate(loKey));
            ulong delta = unchecked(Coordinate(key) - Coordinate(loKey));
            ulong normalizedRange = range >> 0;
            int i;
            if (normalizedRange < (ulong)(hi - lo))
                i = lo + ((hi - lo) >> 1);
            else
            {
                ulong reciprocal = ((ulong)(hi - lo) << 32) / normalizedRange + 1;
                ulong offset = Math.BigMul(delta << 32, reciprocal, out _);
                i = offset > (ulong)(hi - lo) ? hi : lo + (int)offset;
            }

            float midKey = _keys[i];
            if (midKey == key)
                return true;
            if (midKey < key)
                lo = i + 1;
            else
                hi = i - 1;
        }

        return false;
